bio.text: French Hill has represented Arkansas's Second Congressional District since January 2015 and chairs the House Financial Services Committee.
He was Deputy Assistant Secretary of the Treasury for Corporate Finance from 1989 to 1991 and then Executive Secretary of the President's Economic Policy Council.
He was founder, Chairman and CEO of Delta Trust and Banking Corporation from 1999 to 2014.
A graduate of Vanderbilt University in economics, he lives in Little Rock.
